title: Building and signing transactions with CCC

questions.prompt: Which step must happen before a wallet can broadcast an authorized transfer?
questions.explanation: The signer authorizes the transaction before it is sent.

questions.prompt: Why review transaction outputs before signing?
options: To confirm destination, amount, change, and fee
questions.explanation: A signer should verify the exact transaction effects.

questions.prompt: What should be checked after send returns a hash?
options: Transaction status until committed or rejected
questions.explanation: Sending is asynchronous, so status must be followed.
